posts.title: AI At Home Part 2: Multi-GPU Drifting
posts.description: In the last chapter I built a ridiculous home server out of e-waste-grade GPUs to run AI language models. Here, I'll be talking about what I needed to do to squeeze some kind of reasonable performance out of this kind of setup. (This is going to be using existing code and techniques, messing around with llama.cpp settings and so on; writing new ROCm kernels is out of scope for this chapter).
